metadata.tags: A high-energy, lo-fi garage rock track characterized by distorted electric guitars and a driving, rhythmic pulse. The song features a fuzzy, overdriven guitar riff that follows a simple, repetitive chord progression in a minor key. The drums are raw and punchy, utilizing a standard four-on-the-floor kick pattern with crashing cymbals and a crisp snare. The vocals are delivered with a gritty, punk-influenced energy, featuring slight distortion and a mid-range frequency focus that blends into the wall of sound. The production is intentionally unpolished, emphasizing a raw, live-room aesthetic with minimal reverb and a compressed dynamic range. The tempo is fast, approximately 140 BPM, maintaining a relentless forward momentum throughout the arrangement.
